editorial.blurb: This passionate Spanish kitchen crafts phenomenal bocadillos and croquetas that transport you straight to Spain, backed by a James Beard-recognized chef and an uncommonly warm welcome.
editorial.insiderTip: Order multiple sandwiches to share and definitely get the roasted eggplant croquetas—they're the show-stopper. Ask about their dinner menu when you arrive, as the kitchen switches gears from brunch/lunch service.
